#### 1. Joubert syndrome 27  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.715)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:24123)

Loss-of-function mutations in B9D1 disrupt chaperone-mediated autophagy, leading to downstream effects that manifest as cerebellar hypoplasia in MONDO:0013630 and respiratory distress in Joubert syndrome 27.

**How to falsify it:** The hypothesis would be falsified if pathogenic variants in B9D1 were found to be absent in individuals with MONDO:0013630 or Joubert syndrome 27, or if distinct biological pathways were identified as causal for each disease. _(variant: Pathogenic variants in B9D1 showing a minor allele frequency >0.1% in gnomAD.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of B9D1 in both conditions could lead to the development of targeted therapies that address the common pathway defect, potentially benefiting patients with either disease.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of loss-of-function variants in B9D1 or TMEM216 with high allele frequency (>1%) in the gnomAD database, or evidence that these genes function in completely independent cellular pathways in neurons. _(variant: rs12345678)_
